legacy.interpretation: Frozen historical-reference coverage; its training overlap with the heldout genomes is unknown. Labels are not scored.

oracle.sampling: 512 smallest seeded sequence hashes plus at most 32 indexed qualifying references per query
oracle.scope: bounded training-reference subset, not full-corpus exhaustive alignment

policy.homology_stress_scope: sampled query consensuses and all eligible observed variants of retained heldout arrays bearing those consensuses
policy.sampling_unit: unique canonical heldout Bona-fide consensus sequence
policy.training_reference: eligible Bona-fide consensus nodes with retained training-contig occurrences

runtime.comparison_scope: Different workloads; no original-tool runtime or speedup is estimated
